names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 3 Ιουνίου, «Αγία Γλοτίλδη η εκ Γαλλίας», with the rank words left off.

birth.note: saint.gr's head line reads «Αγια Γλοτιλδη η Εκ Γαλλιας (474 - 545)» and the entry says she was born in the city of Lyons in Gaul in 474.

death.note: saint.gr says she fell asleep in peace in 545.

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 3 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and does not carry the «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. saint.gr's head line dates her «(474 - 545)» and the entry is two sentences. It calls her husband a king and so she is a queen in `types`; the page does not name him, and no name is supplied here. Lyons is named as her birthplace and `locations` is left out, because the page places her birth and not her life. The corpus keeps nobody of this name. No hymn is printed.
